name: Easy Slow Cooker Japanese-Style Beef Curry with Potato, Carrot, Celery & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. Quarter potatoes. Peel, trim, and large dice carrots. Trim and large dice celery. Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Place all the veggies in a 6-quart slow cooker insert.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb new potatoes
3 stick celery
1 medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Add beef, broth, and spices to the slow cooker, then stir to combine the curry. Cover slow cooker and cook until veggies are tender and beef is cooked through, 5-6 hours on LOW or HIGH for about 3 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb beef for stew
3 cups beef broth
2 tbsp curry powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the curry has about 30 minutes left, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the rice is cooking, place soy sauce and cornstarch in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the slurry. Add to the slow cooker and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, about 20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp cornstarch

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
